title: MEIKO — Feeling What My Selves Feel〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Look, everyone!
These practice outfits are so white they're sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They are! Where'd you find those, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I noticed this box backstage while I was taking a walk and having a think.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And when I opened it, these were inside♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: SEKAI must be supporting me in what I want to do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh yes, you said you were thinking about something on your walk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right, I remember this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And after that, even the owners of that SEKAI's feelings went to the beach for a training camp.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a talent for seeing the good in people, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a wonderful heart that finds the best in others and an ability to establish goals based on those qualities.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I also agree that you could commit to yourself more. Have more confidence in yourself, you know...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Believe in the part of you that can see those qualities in people.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO...
The cup's already crystal clear, so why are you still polishing it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is like a little spell of sorts.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Even though she's spent so much time polishing herself and can already shine so brilliantly, she's still convinced she's dull... I'm doing this for her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The idol me comes to the forefront and pulls everyone forward, but the cafe owner version of me is the type to give someone that sort of gentle push from behind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've watched over her in plenty of moments like this, but it's always unfair how she's so calm, cool and collected.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something about this is so frustrating. A kind girl like her is suffering because of that kindness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If she's still feeling that way when I see her next, I should take her mind off things with something fun to talk about.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, I think they brought over some drinks.
I guess I'll have one while I brainstorm.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh... This is the last one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No one's looking, so it's mine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now then, time to come up with that fun topic for her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. If Rin or Len had been there in that moment, she definitely would've had her ear talked off about how unfair that was.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, I wonder if she thought of something fun to talk about.
I hope I can hear it from her someday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this...!
I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We... We get to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm really sorry for making you worry so much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me♪
All's well that ends well, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even in shows, it's not so often you get to see such a happy ending.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. You ended up crying too, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I-I couldn't help it.
When I saw all of them crying, I just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. MEIKO might actually be the biggest crybaby out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was also concerned over how things would turn out as I watched over them, so I really understand how she ended up crying too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They struggled and searched for anything they could do, and gave it all so much thought...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We both know everything that went into that happy ending.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And thank you, SEKAI me.
For fighting for them all the way through.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe I was able to get in touch with the feelings of those SEKAI versions of me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Could it be that my wish to meet them was heard by those SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure the SEKAI versions of us are still thinking about the others even in this moment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And I know what I can do for them...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (No matter what, the people behind each SEKAI have their version of me by their side.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And those versions of me each have reliable friends in Miku and the others.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm sure you'll be able to continue the way you've been going...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I don't know who it is, but it's nice.
I can't let myself get shown up like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It feels like it's cheering me on somehow!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright! I'm gonna work my hardest for today's show too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm here too, cheering all of you on.
